description: Shipping Information Centre (PortMIS) - Flinders Ports is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Flinders Ports. This website, PortMIS, contains information about commercial shipping schedules (expected and actual), ships currently in port and cruise ship schedules. All shipping data is sourced directly and online from Flinders Ports - Port Management Information System (PortMIS). Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-12-18. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
